notes.title: Apr 20 Update: Keyboard operation has been added.
Apr. 15 Update: Segmented save feature added.
notes.notes:
April 15th Update Announcement: Segmented Save Function Added
1. A segmented save function has been added. Levels passed through checkpoint locations will be saved. In the future, you can click on Settings -> Save to open the segmented save interface. Use the tab buttons to access the levels at different checkpoint locations.
2. Bugs that might occur to some items under extreme conditions have been fixed.


Upcoming Update Preview: Keyboard and controller operations will be launched.

notes.title: Apr. 14th Update: Fixed the bug that could cause the game to freeze
notes.notes:
Update Note on April 14th: Version number 1.0.07
1. Fixed the bug that might cause the game to freeze after the Ancient Shrine scene is attacked.


Update Preview: The chapter-by-chapter storage function will be launched in version 1.0.08.

notes.title: April 12th Update Notes: Fixed dialog click range/enhanced item usage feel
notes.notes:
First Update Notes on April 12th:
1. The click range of the dialog box has been expanded. Now, the entire dialog box can be clicked.
2. The feel of using items has been fixed. Clicking to use items has become easier and there is no more lag.
3. The bug that allowed the explosive item to be placed repeatedly when in use has been fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for on April 11th: Fixed the bugs that occurred when using the item
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bugs that occur when using the items under extreme circumstances.
2. Shortened the animation duration of the logo and the statement part before the game starts.

notes.title: Update Notes on April 11th: Fixed the bugs that occur when using the Buddha head
notes.notes: The bugs that would occur during usage have been fixed.
